identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Public Health Institute', EIN 94-1646278, Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda's Oakland, CA
Organization's own website lists its Oakland office at 1950 Franklin Street, Suite 600
Its work in public health education and youth health programs fits OUSD's health-focused school academies (Castlemont High School, LIFE Academy) named in the contracts
A PHI press page mentions Castlemont High School in East Oakland
research.notes: Third-party search snippets list an older address (555 12th Street); the organization's own contact page shows 1950 Franklin Street, which is used here. Press page confirming Castlemont mention: https://www.phi.org/press/far-from-parkland-spotlight-teens-in-east-oakland-want-to-tell-their-stories/ (not cited for fields). CA entity number and SAM UEI not looked up.

profile.summary: The Public Health Institute is a national independent nonprofit that works to improve the health and wellbeing of people and communities, especially those facing the greatest barriers. It does research, policy work and leadership training, and serves as a fiscal sponsor for more than 40 public health programs.

sources.title: Public Health Institute - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Exact name match to the Oakland, CA 501(c)(3) Public Health Institute (EIN 94-1646278); its own About and Contact pages support the summary, phone, general email and address, and the district's school-based services fit a public health nonprofit with East Oakland youth programs.
